values.note: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance.' Site-specific. The Florida Forest Service closes every state forest campground when the county is under a tropical storm or hurricane warning, with automatic refunds.

note: Florida Forest Service primitive campground, drive-in via Keri Road (CR 832) and Wildcow Grade.
summary: Confirmed no electric, 16 sites (15 tent-only + site 016 RV-or-tent to 50 ft, back-in on a limerock road), $9.09 fee unchanged, reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months out incl. same day; added year-round season, no potable water, portable restrooms. No 4WD, hunt-season-only or tent-only-for-RV statement; a 23-ft motorhome fits site 016. Note trimmed.
flags: Criteria (borderline): only ONE of the 16 sites takes an RV - sites 001-015 are 'Tent Only'; site 016 is 'RV up to 50ft long' on a soil pad reached by 2.5 miles of limerock road (Wildcow Grade). No 4WD requirement is stated.
Waterfront lead (weak, site-level tag): site 016's details give 'Type of View: Lake'; entry is not waterfront.
Phone: 863-612-0776 is the booking page's contact number; the forest's FDACS page lists the office at (863) 302-6650.

Access caveat to check: FDACS posts 'Effective November 22, 2024, Keri Tower Road is closed due to heavy rain and deteriorating road conditions.' The pages do not tie that road to this camp (site 016 is reached via CR 832 and Wildcow Grade).
